global_rules.task_order: Tasks may be completed in any tier order.
global_rules.tier_claim: Claiming a tier requires all tasks in that tier and all preceding tiers. Pirate Jackie the Fruit in Brimhaven Agility Arena is the current taskmaster for every tier.
global_rules.boostability_default: Temporary boosts may satisfy a task skill requirement unless the task explicitly says otherwise.
global_rules.model_boundary: A proposed action records only a durable task milestone. It never infer-grants variable loot, combat kills, minigame success, crop growth, daily uses, ticket-dispenser availability, or a random transport fare.

completion_states.deterministic: The stated interaction has no variable success boundary.
completion_states.player_confirmed_skill_success: The task has a stochastic skill/minigame success or a state that must be observed.
completion_states.player_confirmed_encounter: The task requires an observed combat/PvP outcome.
completion_states.external_growth_or_rng: A grown crop, harvest state, random fare, or stochastic acquisition remains outside a deterministic account transition.

normalization_proposal.rule: Create one task action per task. A deterministic task action produces only its own durable task milestone; success-, combat-, crop-, fare-, and dispenser-dependent tasks require an observed completion event. Tier claim actions require all task milestones in that tier plus the previous claimed tier.
graph_edges: skill, quest, item, location-access, or observed-event node -> matching task action (requires)
all current-tier task milestones and prior claimed tier -> tier claim action (requires)
tier claim action -> claimed-tier milestone and fixed capabilities (produces)
non_deterministic_boundaries: Arena ticket claims and graahk traps require observed success.
Mining, fishing, woodcutting, karambwan cooking, and red-topaz mining require observed qualifying success.
Jogre, Fight Pits, Ket-Zek, deathwing, and metal-dragon tasks require observed encounter completion.
Fruit, palm, and calquat tasks require observed mature crop health checks.
Charter fares are externally quoted/current-state costs and must not be assumed from a fixed inventory state.

rewards_covered: all four lamps and current recipient restrictions
all listed Medium, Hard, and Elite fixed utility
intentionally_not_modeled_as_actions: combat loot and Slayer assignment contents

conflicts_and_stale_claims.subject: Medium underground Shilo mine access
conflicts_and_stale_claims.detail: The current diary page records this as a Medium reward since 8 May 2024. Any older material placing it at a later tier is stale.

conflicts_and_stale_claims.subject: Hard Slayer task
conflicts_and_stale_claims.detail: Since 10 July 2024, the task is assignment by the Slayer Master in Shilo Village, not specifically Duradel.

conflicts_and_stale_claims.subject: Medium and Hard lamp restrictions
conflicts_and_stale_claims.detail: Since 14 January 2026, the 5,000-XP Medium lamp requires the selected skill to be at least 30, and the 10,000-XP Hard lamp requires at least 40. Older guides commonly omit these restrictions.

conflicts_and_stale_claims.subject: Elite reward list
conflicts_and_stale_claims.detail: Older 2015 reward summaries omit later/current listed benefits such as free cart rides, noted metal-dragon bars, and the current full Tokkul sources. The current diary page is authoritative for this package.

conflicts_and_stale_claims.subject: Task language versus deterministic simulation
conflicts_and_stale_claims.detail: The diary records only completion requirements. Combat readiness, minigame success, crop maturity, variable charter fare, and random/dispenser outcomes remain observed account state rather than automatic transitions.
